review_improvement: Prevents three different indicator states from being conflated and confines any future rebuild execution to an explicitly approved, traceable disposable-array lifecycle.
independent_technical_reasoning: Present reflects occupancy, Locate reflects a service command, and Rebuild reflects a controller recovery process; they can illuminate different lamps or patterns and are not interchangeable. Since the source supplies no degraded/replacement transition, any automatic rebuild procedure would be invented and potentially destructive, so only engineering can define the missing state machine.
